file.content: Todos

lines: +  .search { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1rem; padding: .5rem; font-size: 1rem; }
+  li input[data-testid="todo-edit"] { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: .25rem; font: inherit; }
+<input class="search" data-testid="search-input" type="search" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search todos" autocomplete="off">
+  // Search: case-insensitive substring on text; applied on top of the status filter.
// Project rule: active todos first, completed below; within each group, sorted by priority.
+  // Enter and blur commit, Escape cancels. Empty text keeps the original.
// Re-render when the local calendar day changes so overdue flags stay current.

content.text:
I added both features to `index.html`. Only a syntax check has been run; I haven't tested either feature in a browser.

Chose: Double-click opens an edit field (`todo-edit`). If the edited text is blank, the original is kept, the same way Add ignores blank input. Search lives only in memory, is not saved, and runs before the existing filter and priority sort.
Why: A guard stops the edit from saving twice when Enter or Escape is followed by blur. The midnight overdue refresh waits while an edit is open so it doesn't close it.
Rejected: Deleting a todo when its text is cleared (that would remove data silently), and saving the search term to localStorage (the spec didn't ask for it).
